mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as central bank accommodation boosts risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 3-month moving averages indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns as revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns when their correlation drops below 0.7 in a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong residential construction demand, correlating with higher corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST increases by ≥1.0% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative central bank policy reduces risk-free rates, increasing equity valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Expanding employment (PAYEMS) boosts consumer income and spending, correlating with higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS increases by ≥0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1100.0 (thousands of units) signals residential construction contraction, reducing economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when HOUST drops below 1100.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
